yahoo.description: Yahoo Finance market data: quotes, price history, financial statements, analyst ratings. Yahoo needs exchange suffixes: ASX codes end in .AX (CPU.AX), KRX in .KS (000660.KS), KOSDAQ in .KQ, NZX in .NZ, LSE in .L; US tickers have none. Convert Sharesight codes before calling. For beta, P/E or other key stats across many stocks, use compare_stocks: it takes up to 10 tickers per call, so split a long list into groups of 10 and make all those calls at once.

sharesight.description: Sharesight portfolios. Never ask the user for portfolio IDs or holdings: call list_portfolios first (it names every portfolio and its owner), then get_performance_report for the ones involved. A report's holdings list is exactly their current positions, with quantity, value and gains. When comparing portfolios or explaining a result, write 2-3 short paragraphs: each portfolio's return, then its tailwinds (biggest contributors, with numbers) and headwinds (biggest detractors), and what explains the gap.
